standard_prerequisites.name: idtoiso
standard_prerequisites.statement: For p : a = a' the isomorphism idtoiso(p) : a ~ a' is defined by induction from the identity isomorphism.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the conjugation map appearing on the right-hand side of the displayed equation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transport in a hom-type
standard_prerequisites.statement: For p : a = a' and q : b = b' the transport of f : hom_A(a,b) along (p,q) is a morphism hom_A(a',b').
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the left-hand side of the displayed equation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Path induction
standard_prerequisites.statement: To prove a statement about paths it suffices to prove it for reflexivity.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the sole proof step at source line 175.

core_obligations: Apply path induction to assume p and q are reflexivity at a and b respectively (source line 175).
Compute the left-hand side of the displayed equation, which is then simply f (source line 176).
Compute the right-hand side: idtoiso(refl) is the identity morphism, so the conjugation reduces to 1_b o f o 1_a, which equals f by the precategory axioms (source line 177).
Conclude the equation by the two computations (source line 177).

proof_roadmap.step: Path induction and the computation of the left-hand side.
Compute idtoiso at reflexivity and use the unit laws.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.1.9 at source lines 167-173: for paths p : a = a', q : b = b' and a morphism f : hom_A(a,b), the transport of f along (p,q) equals the conjugate idtoiso(q) o f o inv(idtoiso(p)). The author's proof (source lines 174-178) is a short computation, but both sides must be evaluated: the left-hand side collapses to f under path induction (line 176), and the right-hand side requires knowing that idtoiso at a reflexivity is the identity morphism, after which the unit laws of the precategory finish the identification (line 177). The statement is an equation between a transport and a composite and records neither the induction nor the evaluation of idtoiso.
